- When sentiment is positive (≥0.10) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤-0.20), model often underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is rising.
- Model frequently overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +30%+ in 3-5 days); cap forecast at 10-15% above recent peak.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show downward trend, model often fails to correct; add 5-10% upward bias to counteract.
- For 30-day horizon, model underestimates in high-sentiment periods; increase forecast by 2-5% relative to 14-day moving average.
- If sentiment is volatile (alternating +/–), model tends to lag; add 1-3 days of lead time in forecast adjustment.
